name: Attack on Camp Narache
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.

Surely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many tauren, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have a look of concern about you, adventurer. What news do you bring?
